title: Playboy Magazine August 1973 Watergate Tapes David Halberstam Porno Chic
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows toning and scattered soiling, most noticeable as dark smudging at the upper left, along with general edge and corner wear. Spine intact. No mailing label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, August 1973 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- At Last, the Watergate Tapes! Never Before Published, Leaked or Shredded! - published while the Senate hearings were still running
- An Exclusive Interview with David Halberstam, the year after "The Best and the Brightest"
- Porno Chic: Hard-Core Films Come Out of the Closet - a look at the "Deep Throat" moment when adult film briefly went mainstream
- Playboy's History of Organized Crime in America

Blue beach cover.

The back cover carries a 1973 Salem "refreshes naturally!" menthol ad, with the FTC figures dated Feb '73.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
